contexts.text: (Consequences of using Scripture in common conversation, and jesting.) SE 1304.
Human conversation enters through the ear, by an external way; but the conversation of Spirits does not enter through the ear... but by an internal way...
From Whom alone there are discourse, and the Word. SE 2141.
When they hear the discourse they have no root in themselves... Afterwards, when affliction and persecution arise because of the discourse, they are at once offended ().
In common conversation. AC 2245. AC 2701:end. AC 3693. AC 4624. AC 4653.

(The conversation of the Angels seen representatively in the World of Spirits.) AC 2729. AC 3216. AC 3217. AC 3218. AC 3219. AC 3220. AC 3221. AC 3699. AC 5198:2. AC 5201:4. AC 5313:13. AC 8215:2. AC 9125:3. AC 9139:2. AC 9166. AC 9272:2. AR 661:end.
When anything false or evil is infused, either in conversation by an evil man, or in thought by an evil Spirit, the Angels at once turn it into something true or good...

By the life is not meant how it appears in conversation and works, but how it is in conversation and works; for the life of the conversation is from the thought, and the life of the works is from the will; both from the intention or end; such, therefore, as is the intention or end in the conversation or works, such is the life; for conversation without interior life is only sound...

Thought is the cause, and conversation the effect; if there is correspondence, faith from charity inflows into the thought, and this into the conversation, and they so act as one, that the conversation, through correspondence, is as it were the end.
His character was not at first evident from his conversation.
(Effect of cheerful conversation at meal times.)
Giving discourses of elegance () = gladness of mind... For all discourse proceeds from the mind... AE 439:2.
Under Converse, see this reference.
There were five Societies which manifested themselves through living discourse...
Things which cast a shade, which are chiefly the affections of elegance of discourse and of learning; for these things hide the real things...
The truth which proceeds immediately from the Divine cannot be presented to anyone as discourse, or speech, except through the Holy Spirit. Explained.
Angelic discourse is continuous. Explained.

The form of Heaven is represented in angelic discourse. In all angelic discourse there is a harmony like that of songs, which, in every termination, ceases in a monosyllable, thus in unity... The reason is that everything in Heaven relates to one God... Hence it is evident, that everything of thought, and thence of discourse, flows in through Heaven from the Lord, and hence there is such a harmony in the discourse which terminates in unity.

In the mouth = in the discourse, and in the discourse are both parts of the mind... the Intellectual in the sense of the words and things, the Voluntary in the affection, which gives life to the discourse.
(Delight in conversation at meals in Jupiter.)
The Spirits of Jupiter possess a sweet address and sagacious conversation; they consider what they say.
With the Angels, all things of their discourse are open even to the Lord, which is clearly perceived, and is also heard from the softness and quality of it...
Everyone who... heareth My sayings, and doeth them (). To hear the words, or sayings = to learn and know the precepts of faith which are from the Lord.
In the general sense, a word = an utterance of the mouth, or a discourse...
(In the fourth Earth) they join in conversation through the face and lips, and through sound varied according to the ideas of thought...
They who are in the mouth and tongue are in conversation from the understanding and perception.
The discourses of the Angels of the inmost Heaven are never perceived in the middle Heaven...
It has been granted to he with some (of the ancients) in familiar conversation.
(Sermons of the English which leave it doubtful whether good is to be done, or not.)
(When the English clergy are preparing their sermons, or preachings...)
(The neatness and elegance of the discourse of the solifidians.) Signified.
The priest ascended the pulpit, and delivered a sermon full of the spirit of wisdom...
Application of all things of conversation to what is libidinous.
There was an exaltation as from the fire of love in the discourse of the Angels.
A talking about love by the wife.
As they know that the laity regard these things as saving... they diligently subjoin them to their sermons and conversation... See BE 59.
Such is the state of thought and conversation of satans after death.
While they were in conversation about Redemption...
He began a sermon on the Divine Trinity.
Has been made known to me from conversation with many of the laity...
It is a common saying.
At table they had conversations about various things...
The Angels know man's love from the tone, and his intelligence from the discourse... Wherefore, all things which proceed from man, whether action or discourse, make the man, and are the man himself.

The principal reason why those preachers are deprived of their office, is that they do not frame their sermons from the Word... but from their own rational light... They take texts from the Word, but merely touch them with their lips.
(During their examination by the Angels) while their discourse flows easily, it is in agreement with the act of their life... SE 1355.
The discourse of Spirits inflowed unexpectedly into my ideas...
When I was in tacit discourse with Spirits...
1.2. (What sermons ought to be.)
Let the sayings of my mouth, and the meditation of my heart be before Thee ()... The sayings of the mouth = the understanding of truth; and the meditation of the heart, the perception of good.
The discourse of Jehovah () = the Divine good from which is Divine truth.
